warmup: one acyclic call before timings; no result cache
sampling: 24 iid uniform labelled six-tuples in [-3,3]; 12 iid acyclic nonnegative tuples in [0,2]^6, each mutated by six iid uniform vertices; all draws kept
limits: named 100000 discovered states / 3s; generated 25000 states / 1s; cooperative timeout checked once per expansion
timing: perf_counter inside analyze_tuple; includes bound calculation, shortcuts, search and independent MA witness replay; excludes import/JSON I/O
counter_scope: mutation_evaluations counts candidate mutations in search/descent/line reduction; witness_check_mutations separately counts independent verification; fixed-word guards construct words without mutation; states_discovered/expanded and max_frontier count BFS only; finite-orbit certificate is verified at module import, outside timings
hardware_note: Read with /usr/sbin/sysctl after benchmark, same host; initial sandbox prevented hardware reads.
